description:
FILED s528 (Fable, 2026-10-25), from the round-5 FULL companion on main 31cd8c02 (code) / 9c67c2f2.  op/each.t: counts STABLE 48/16 (snapshot = run) but the ROW DIFF prints `+ op/each.t  Check length of "\x{123}"` and `- op/each.t  Check length of "\x{10fffd}"` -- ONE row, number 29, pcl `(missing)` both times; the description is `"Check length of " . _qq $_` inside `for (keys %h)`, so it carries whichever key the hash iteration hands out first (the s524 round-4 snapshot note already records the flap: \x{10fffd} / \x{123} / \022 in four runs of ONE tree).  The runner's only opt-out is file-level: a file whose blessed rows are exactly ONE `*rows-unstable*` entry (tools/run-perl-suite.pl ~1312 / ~1363); op/each.t has 15 STABLE blessed rows beside this one, so the whole-file opt-out would blind the diff to real movers in them.

SHAPE (ruled): a blessed row may carry the marker `*desc-unstable*` at the START of its cause column; the row diff then matches it by (file, row number) alone and prints it as `=` (unverified-by-description) instead of NEW/FIXED; everything else unchanged.  Bless op/each.t row 29 with it (cause: the hash-order key in the description; pcl `(missing)` = the row is one of the never-produced ones).  Bar: the runner changed = run it ONCE (one-file: `tools/run-perl-suite.pl --jobs 1 op/each.t`) and compare the verdict + the ROW DIFF lines with the s528 full run's (`~/pcl-agent-scratch/s528/companion-full.log`); `tools/t/*.t` for the runner if any; `Pl/t/no-hardcoded-paths-01.t`.  Runner-only: nothing in Pl/ cl/ lib/.  A filler for a free slot; it does NOT block the round.
subject: run-perl-suite.pl row diff: a blessed row whose DESCRIPTION interpolates a hash key (op/each.t row 29 `Check length of "\x{...}"`) is reported NEW + FIXED on every run -- add a per-ROW `*desc-unstable*` marker (match by file + row number) so a file with one unstable description is not forced to the whole-file `*rows-unstable*` opt-out
